gameTermChipsBody: The base material for score calculation, set by hand type and chip bonuses. Chips are not held or spent like gold.
gameTermScorePercentBody: Raises this confirm score by a percentage after chips are counted. Score +20% makes the final score 1.2x.
gameTermScoreMultiplierBody: A stronger multiplier applied at the end. Score x2 really doubles the score.
gameTermGoldBody: Currency used in the market to buy Jesters and Items or reroll offers.
